text: Seven-Class Edition – Class 6: Agents, Harnesses & Executionhttps://haas-ai-classes-fall-26.vercel.app/class6.html#/title-slide32/104 MCP: How AI Apps Connect to Tools and DataMCP means Model Context Protocol: an open standard for AI applications to discoverand use external tools and data. An AI application or harness contains a model and anMCP client. The client discovers tool names and input schemas through tools/list, sends atool name and arguments through tools/call, and receives a result or error.
